name: CaseGridChildAlign
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-child-align" (grid-alignment). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: justify-self: center; align-self: end on a fixed-size child
